description: This file implements a static method 'PostMortem' within the 'Server' class in the 'WPEFramework::PluginHost' namespace. The method handles generating a post-mortem dump for a service, either by dumping system files directly or by instructing a remote connection to do so, depending on whether the connection is internal or external.

classes.name: Server
classes.description: A class within the WPEFramework::PluginHost namespace that contains the static method 'PostMortem' for handling post-mortem diagnostics.

methods.name: PostMortem
methods.description: Handles the process of generating a post-mortem dump for a given service, depending on whether the connection is internal or external, and whether post-mortem is allowed.
